annotations.title: Find times for a presentation or training

description: Find open times (Brasília time) for an online All4Clinic product presentation ("apresentacao", for clinics evaluating the system) or a team training session ("treinamento", for clinics already using it). Each time comes with a booking_url that opens the booking page with that day and time chosen; the person confirms there with their name, e-mail and WhatsApp. Nothing is booked by this tool.

from.description: First day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the next available day.

type.description: "apresentacao" = product presentation for a clinic evaluating All4Clinic; "treinamento" = training for the team of a clinic that already uses it.

name: find_meeting_times
